select row_number() over (order by s.reg_dtm desc, s.survey_seq desc) as row_no, s.survey_seq, s.survey_uid, s.title, count(f.field_seq) as field_count, s.use_yn, date(s.reg_dtm) as reg_date, date(s.mod_dtm) as mod_date from sa_survey_mst s left join sa_survey_field_dtl f on f.survey_seq = s.survey_seq
group by s.survey_seq, s.survey_uid, s.title, s.use_yn, s.reg_dtm, s.mod_dtm order by s.reg_dtm desc, s.survey_seq desc

select row_number() over (order by s.reg_dtm desc, s.survey_seq desc) as row_no, s.survey_seq, s.survey_uid, s.title, count(f.field_seq) as field_count, s.use_yn, date(s.reg_dtm) as reg_date, date(s.mod_dtm) as mod_date from sa_survey_mst s left join sa_survey_field_dtl f on f.survey_seq = s.survey_seq where s.use_yn = 'Y' and s.delete_flg = 'N' group by s.survey_seq, s.survey_uid, s.title, s.use_yn, s.reg_dtm, s.mod_dtm order by s.reg_dtm desc, s.survey_seq desc

select row_number() over (order by case when s.use_yn = 'Y' then 0 else 1 end, s.reg_dtm desc, s.survey_seq desc) as row_no, s.survey_seq, s.survey_uid, s.title, count(f.field_seq) as field_count, s.use_yn, date(s.reg_dtm) as reg_date, date(s.mod_dtm) as mod_date from sa_survey_mst s left join sa_survey_field_dtl f on f.survey_seq = s.survey_seq where s.delete_flg = 'N' group by s.survey_seq, s.survey_uid, s.title, s.use_yn, s.reg_dtm, s.mod_dtm order by case when s.use_yn = 'Y' then 0 else 1 end, s.reg_dtm desc, s.survey_seq desc

select row_number() over (order by s.reg_dtm desc, s.survey_seq desc) as row_no, s.survey_seq, s.survey_uid, s.title, count(f.field_seq) as field_count, s.use_yn, date(s.reg_dtm) as reg_date, date(s.mod_dtm) as mod_date from sa_survey_mst s left join sa_survey_field_dtl f on f.survey_seq = s.survey_seq where s.use_yn = 'Y' and s.delete_flg = 'N' group by s.survey_seq, s.survey_uid, s.title, s.use_yn, s.reg_dtm, s.mod_dtm order by s.reg_dtm desc, s.survey_seq desc limit #{limit}
select survey_seq, survey_uid, title, description, use_yn, date(reg_dtm) as reg_date, date(mod_dtm) as mod_date from sa_survey_mst where survey_uid = #{surveyUid} and delete_flg = 'N'
select field_seq, survey_seq, field_key, field_label as label, field_type, required_yn, sort_ord from sa_survey_field_dtl where survey_seq = #{surveySeq} order by sort_ord, field_seq

select o.field_opt_seq, o.field_seq, o.option_label, o.option_value, o.sort_ord from sa_survey_field_opt_dtl o join sa_survey_field_dtl f on f.field_seq = o.field_seq where f.survey_seq = #{surveySeq} order by f.sort_ord, o.sort_ord, o.field_opt_seq
mapper.insert: insert into sa_survey_mst (survey_uid, title, description, use_yn, reg_dtm, reg_id, mod_dtm, mod_id) values (#{surveyUid}, #{title}, #{description}, #{useYn}, now(), 'system', now(), 'system')
mapper.update: update sa_survey_mst set title = #{title}, description = #{description}, use_yn = #{useYn}, mod_dtm = now() where survey_seq = #{surveySeq}
mapper.delete: delete o from sa_survey_field_opt_dtl o join sa_survey_field_dtl f on f.field_seq = o.field_seq where f.survey_seq = #{surveySeq}
mapper.update: update sa_survey_mst set delete_flg = 'Y', use_yn = 'N', mod_dtm = now(), mod_id = 'system' where survey_seq = #{surveySeq}
mapper.insert: insert into sa_survey_field_dtl (survey_seq, field_key, field_label, field_type, required_yn, sort_ord, reg_dtm, reg_id, mod_dtm, mod_id) values (#{surveySeq}, #{fieldKey}, #{label}, #{fieldType}, #{requiredYn}, #{sortOrd}, now(), 'system', now(), 'system')

insert into sa_survey_field_opt_dtl (field_seq, option_label, option_value, sort_ord, reg_dtm, reg_id, mod_dtm, mod_id) values (#{fieldSeq}, #{optionLabel}, #{optionValue}, #{sortOrd}, now(), 'system', now(), 'system')
